scope: Five independently combinable phrasing strategies over six base composition strategies, finite expressive renderer, complete Standard MIDI type1 export and CLI. Existing live PWA/Android, drum bank and old offline recipe APIs are unchanged.

findingsFixed: Lyrical gates now stop before every retained following note, including phrase-ending bars.
Expression uses pre-sample-rounding musical gateBeats, avoiding half-beat rounding ambiguity between 44.1/48kHz.
MIDI bar/marker/style metadata is bounded and checked against the finite score duration.
All shared percussion-channel notes use one MIDI track, preserving note-off-before-retrigger order across source layers.
independentChecks.finalFixtures: PASS: lyrical overlaps zero across six strategies; percussion OFF then ON at tick960; out-of-range markers and oversized metadata rejected.

limitations: MIDI1 overlaps of equal pitch/channel are shortened or coalesced and counted.
Pan is a per-melodic-track average; MIDI1 cannot preserve simultaneous independent per-note pan on one channel. Drum pan is left to the host.
GM programs only suggest playback; exact Surge/plugin timbres require the host and a saved patch.
SMF byte/parser checks do not establish successful REAPER or hardware playback.

limits: No browser, live AudioWorklet or Android integration claimed.
